BUCKET.CURSORS.summary: Lists all active cursors for the current session.
BUCKET.CURSORS.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of open cursors in the session.

reply_schema.description: The open cursors, grouped by operation. Only the requested operation is listed when one is given.

additionalProperties.description: The cursors of one operation, keyed by cursor id.
The filter expression of the cursor, as a JSON string.

arguments.name: operation
arguments.summary: List the cursors of this operation only. All operations are listed when this is left out.
